links.outcome: Documentation time and clinical productivity after ambient scribe implementation among pharmacists
links.effect: 31.17% reduction in median time documenting notes per day (38.5 vs. 26.5 min, p = 0.04); visit increases not statistically significant.
links.quote: Nine ambient AI documentation tool users demonstrated a 31.17% reduction in median time spent documenting notes per day (38.5 vs. 26.5 min, p = 0.04).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment and workflow impact of an ambient AI documentation tool on clinical pharmacists, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail comparison.
